narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To illustrate the surge in imported COVID-19 cases in Taiwan during March 2020, which occurred while local community spread remained low, thereby explaining the need for new strategies.

units.meaning: Imported cases rose sharply across March, from low single digits to late-March peaks in the 20s.
accepted_routes: Imported cases jumped from 2 in late Feb to 29 by late March.
March imported cases climbed from single digits to 20s.
Imported bar heights rise sharply across March 2020.
Imported cases surged to peaks of 27 and 29 in late March.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Imported bars visibly grow from low early values to 27 and 29 in late March.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause 'in March, cases coming into Taiwan began to rise'
units.reviewer_question: Must the video show the rising imported trend across multiple March dates?

units.meaning: Local community cases remained low throughout, with the highest local bar only 8.
accepted_routes: Local cases stayed low, peaking at only 8.
Community spread remained low, with local bars mostly 1 to 3.
The tallest local bar reaches just 8.
Local case counts remain small while imported counts rise.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Local bars stay low and never exceed height 8 on the chart.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause 'Community spread among people in Taiwan was very, very low'
units.reviewer_question: Must the video state or show that local cases remained low?

units.meaning: In the 25 Mar section, imported cases far outnumbered local cases: 72 imported vs 11 local.
accepted_routes: In the 25 Mar section, imported cases were 72 vs 11 local.
Late-March imported cases outnumbered local about 6.5 to 1.
Imported bars dwarf local bars in the 25 Mar section.
25 Mar section shows 72 imported and 11 local cases.
units.visual_evidence_rule: In the 25 Mar section, imported bars are much taller than the local bars.
units.temporal_anchor: the contrast between imported rise and low local spread in March
units.reviewer_question: Must the video directly compare imported and local counts in late March?

units.meaning: Imported cases made up almost all reported cases in the 17 Mar section: 106 of 109.
accepted_routes: In Mar 17-24, imported cases were 97% of all cases.
Imported share was about 106 of 109 cases.
Nearly all cases in that March section were imported.
Imported cases dominated composition: 97.2% versus 2.8% local.
units.visual_evidence_rule: In the 17 Mar section, imported bars visually dominate and local bars are tiny.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause 'cases coming into Taiwan began to rise'
units.reviewer_question: Should the video quantify imported share rather than only compare heights?

units.meaning: Imported cases overtook local cases by the 09 Mar section: 27 imported vs 5 local.
units.computation: 27 Feb: imported 2+2+1=5, local 1+4+1=6; 09 Mar: imported 1+5+5+8+3+5=27, local 1+1+3=5
accepted_routes: Imported cases overtook local cases between late Feb and early March.
By 09 Mar, imported cases were 27 vs 5 local.
Imported cases crossed above local counts by the 09 Mar section.
Early March marks the point when imported cases exceeded local cases.
units.visual_evidence_rule: By the 09 Mar section, imported bars clearly exceed local bars.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause 'in March, cases coming into Taiwan began to rise'
units.reviewer_question: Should the video mark the crossing point when imported cases overtook local?

optional_valid: Mention specific date labels such as 17 Mar 20 and 25 Mar 20.
Show the local peak of 8 on 25 Mar 20.
Highlight imported peak of 29 on 25 Mar 20.
Use color legend distinguishing Local from Imported.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal claim that imported cases directly caused the new strategy.
Treating relative_value as a share of total cases.
Claiming local spread was zero or nonexistent.
Summing all March cases without stating the formula.
notes: Focus on imported surge versus low local spread. Share and crossing units are optional but valid if quantified correctly.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
